title: Hermite polynomial under Gaussian affine averaging
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $\rho,s,x\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $\rho^2+s^2=1$. The standard Gaussian integral of the Hermite polynomial of degree $k$ evaluated at $\rho x+s y$ equals $\rho^k$ times the Hermite polynomial of degree $k$ evaluated at $x$.
